GORIDE · RENTAL TERMS

SELF-DRIVE DEPOSIT₹3,000 refundable
BOOKING STATUSOwner confirmation required

1. Booking with GoRide

GoRide offers self-drive and chauffeur rental requests in Bangalore, Chennai and Tirupati, subject to availability. A submitted request is not a confirmed reservation. GoRide must accept the request and agree the price with you. The website and app currently do not collect online payments.

Before confirmation, obtain a written quote identifying the vehicle, rental type, exact pick-up and return times and place, total price and taxes, included kilometres and hours, fuel arrangement, extra-kilometre and overtime rates, delivery fees, tolls, parking and interstate permits. Undisclosed extras require your agreement before they are incurred. Images illustrate the model; confirm the actual vehicle and condition at handover.

2. Who may drive

Self-drive drivers must be at least 21 and hold an original, valid driving licence accepted in India for the vehicle class throughout the rental. GoRide checks eligibility before handover. Only drivers approved in writing may drive. International driving documents require prior approval. A chauffeur booking may be requested by an adult aged 18 or older; passengers may not drive the vehicle.

3. Security deposit

The refundable security deposit for self-drive is ₹3,000, separate from rent. Any chauffeur deposit must be expressly quoted before confirmation. The deposit is not a limit on responsibility for proven loss. Deductions must be itemised and supported by evidence for agreed unpaid charges, attributable damage beyond ordinary wear, missing items, fuel shortfall or actual traffic fines. Normal wear and pre-existing damage are excluded. You may dispute a deduction before settlement. See the cancellation and refund policy for the proposed return timeline.

4. Pick-up, return and extensions

Inspect and record the vehicle together at pick-up and return: existing damage, fuel, odometer, accessories and documents. Ask for a copy of the handover record. Return to the agreed location and time with the agreed fuel level. Request an extension before the return time; it depends on availability and written approval of the additional price. Late return does not automatically extend the booking. There is no unquoted flat late-return, cleaning or damage penalty.

5. Safe and permitted use

Follow road laws, seat-belt rules and vehicle capacity. No impaired driving, racing, unlawful use, subletting, unauthorised commercial use or off-road driving. Obtain written approval for interstate routes and confirm permits and charges. Use the correct fuel. Tell GoRide promptly about breakdowns, loss or accidents; contact emergency services first if anyone is in danger. Do not arrange non-emergency repairs without approval. GoRide will explain available assistance; a replacement car is subject to availability.

6. Chauffeur trips

Agree the route, included hours and kilometres, driver allowance, night charges, waiting time and outstation arrangements in writing. Changes require an updated quote. Treat drivers respectfully and allow safe breaks. GoRide may stop an unsafe trip, explaining the reason and calculating any charge fairly for services actually provided.

7. Insurance and responsibility

Ask GoRide for the actual vehicle insurance cover, exclusions, excess and claim procedure before accepting a self-drive rental. Do not assume damage is fully covered. Responsibility depends on the facts, applicable law, disclosed rental conditions and valid insurance. GoRide will provide evidence for any claim and will not charge twice for a loss recovered from insurance or another party. These terms do not exclude responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded.

8. Accounts, documents and reviews

Provide accurate details and keep your account secure. Email and password login does not verify ownership of your email or phone. Driving-licence images are private. Aadhaar is optional: upload only a masked image showing the last four digits, with separate consent. Ask GoRide about alternative identity documents. Approved reviews are published only when you choose publication; private feedback is for GoRide. See the privacy policy.

9. Cancellation, complaints and your rights

The linked cancellation policy explains the proposed charges and refunds. Report booking or service complaints using the contact details below. GoRide aims to acknowledge complaints within 48 hours and resolve them within one month, with updates if investigation is needed. Indian law applies. Your statutory consumer rights and access to appropriate consumer authorities remain available. New policy versions will not retrospectively increase charges on an existing confirmed booking.

Contact GoRide

Email goride@gmail.com, WhatsApp +91 9100852287 or call +91 8610235694. Include your booking reference. Never send a password, recovery code or unmasked Aadhaar.
